editorial:
If you like spooky stories that still feel warm and funny, ParaNorman is a great pick. Norman Babcock is a kid who can talk to ghosts, but everyone in Blithe Hollow treats him like the weird one. When his strange uncle warns him about a witch's curse, Norman has to step up and protect the town. The movie mixes silly jokes, creepy moments, and a lot of heart, so it never feels too dark for family night. The stop-motion animation looks amazing, with lots of tiny details that make the town feel alive. You'll root for Norman because he is brave even when people do not believe him.

The voice acting is strong, and the pacing keeps things moving without rushing the emotional parts. Some scenes might be a little scary for very young kids, but older children and adults will appreciate the clever humor and sweet message about not judging people. The movie also has a fun twist that makes the witch story more than a simple monster chase. If you want a cozy Halloween-style adventure, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture. It is a smart, funny family film that earns its heart.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Norman learns the witch is actually Agatha, a girl who was punished for being different. Instead of fighting her, he talks to her and helps her let go of her anger. The zombies return to their graves, the curse ends, and the town finally accepts Norman. The twist is that the real monster was fear and cruelty, not the witch herself.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spooky family adventures with heart.
